active_directory.name: Add User to AD Group
active_directory.description: Add a user to an Active Directory security group
active_directory.template:
# Add User to AD Group
Add-ADGroupMember -Identity '{{group_name}}' -Members '{{username}}'

active_directory.name: Remove User from AD Group
active_directory.description: Remove a user from an Active Directory security group
active_directory.template:
# Remove User from AD Group
Remove-ADGroupMember -Identity '{{group_name}}' -Members '{{username}}' -Confirm:$false

active_directory.name: Add to Local Administrators
active_directory.description: Add a user or group to the local Administrators group on a computer

active_directory.name: Get AD User Info
active_directory.description: Display detailed information for an AD user
active_directory.template:
# Get AD User Info
Get-ADUser -Identity '{{username}}' -Properties * | Format-List

active_directory.name: List AD Group Members
active_directory.description: List all members of an Active Directory group
active_directory.template:
# List AD Group Members
Get-ADGroupMember -Identity '{{group_name}}' | Format-Table Name, SamAccountName, objectClass -AutoSize

local_users.name: Create Local User
local_users.description: Create a local user account on the computer

local_users.name: Reset Local User Password
local_users.description: Reset password for a local user account
local_users.template:
# Reset Local User Password
$user = Get-LocalUser -Name '{{username}}'
$user | Set-LocalUser -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString '{{new_password}}' -AsPlainText -Force)

local_users.name: List Local Users
local_users.description: List all local user accounts on the computer
local_users.template:
# List Local Users
Get-LocalUser | Format-Table Name, Enabled, LastLogon -AutoSize

security.name: Event Log Hunter
security.description: Search Event Log for specific Event IDs
security.template:
# Event Log Hunter
$ids = '{{event_ids}}' -split ',' | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Trim() }
$start = (Get-Date).AddHours(-[int]'{{hours}}')
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName='{{log_name}}'; Id=$ids; StartTime=$start } -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize -Wrap

security.name: Check Firewall Status
security.description: Check Windows Firewall status for all profiles
security.template:
# Firewall Status
Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select-Object Name, Enabled | Format-Table -AutoSize

security.name: BitLocker Status
security.description: Check BitLocker encryption status on drives
security.template:
# BitLocker Status
Get-BitLockerVolume | Format-Table MountPoint, EncryptionMethod, ProtectionStatus, EncryptionPercentage -AutoSize

security.name: Last Logon Report
security.description: Get last logon for domain users

system_maintenance.name: Clear Temp Files
system_maintenance.description: Clear user and Windows temp folders
system_maintenance.template:
# Clear Temp Files (run as admin for full clean)
Remove-Item $env:TEMP\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item C:\Windows\Temp\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Temp folders cleared' -ForegroundColor Green

system_maintenance.name: Check Critical Services
system_maintenance.description: Check status of critical Windows services

system_info.name: List Installed Updates
system_info.template:
# Installed Updates
Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Format-Table HotFixID, Description, InstalledOn -AutoSize

system_info.name: Disk Space Report
system_info.description: Report disk space on all drives
system_info.template:
# Disk Space
Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, @{N='Used(GB)';E={[math]::Round($_.Used/1GB,2)}}, @{N='Free(GB)';E={[math]::Round($_.Free/1GB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

windows_updates.name: Check for Windows Updates
windows_updates.template:
# Check for Updates (run as admin)
$UpdateSession = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session
$UpdateSearcher = $UpdateSession.CreateUpdateSearcher()
$SearchResult = $UpdateSearcher.Search('IsInstalled=0')
Write-Host "Updates available: $($SearchResult.Updates.Count)"
$SearchResult.Updates | Select-Object Title

windows_updates.name: Reset Windows Update
windows_updates.description: Stop Windows Update services and clear cache
windows_updates.template:
# Reset Windows Update (run as admin)
Stop-Service wuauserv -Force; Stop-Service bits -Force
Remove-Item C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service wuauserv; Start-Service bits
Write-Host 'Windows Update reset complete'

activation.name: Activate via KMS
activation.template:
echo office2016 cd /d %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Office\Office16

cd /d %ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Office\Office16

for /f %x in ('dir /b ..\root\Licenses16\ProPlus2021VL_KMS*.xrm-ms') do cscript ospp.vbs /inslic:"..\root\Licenses16\%x"

cscript ospp.vbs /setprt:1688

cscript ospp.vbs /unpkey:6F7TH >nul

cscript ospp.vbs /inpkey:FXYTK-NJJ8C-GB6DW-3DYQT-6F7TH

cscript ospp.vbs /sethst:e8.us.to

cscript ospp.vbs /act
PAUSE
exit
exit
cd /d %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Office\Office16

remote_desktop.name: Enable Remote Desktop
remote_desktop.description: Enable Remote Desktop on the computer
remote_desktop.template:
# Enable RDP (run as admin)
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name 'fDenyTSConnections' -Value 0
Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup 'Remote Desktop'

remote_desktop.name: Disable Remote Desktop
remote_desktop.template:
# Disable RDP (run as admin)
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name 'fDenyTSConnections' -Value 1

browser_tools.name: Clear IE/Edge Cache
browser_tools.description: Clear Internet Explorer and Edge cache

troubleshooting.name: Register DNS
troubleshooting.description: Register DNS records for this computer

troubleshooting.name: SFC System File Check
troubleshooting.description: Scan and repair system files (run as admin)

domain_migration.name: Migrate User Account (ADMT-style)
domain_migration.description: Template for migrating a user account to new domain
domain_migration.template:
# Migrate User - Use ADMT or manual process
# 1. Export from source: Get-ADUser -Identity '{{source_user}}' -Properties * | Export-Clixml user.xml
# 2. Create in target: New-ADUser -Path '{{target_ou}}' -Name ... (copy attributes)
# 3. Use ADMT for SID history, passwords, profiles
# Or run: ADMT USER /N "DOMAIN\user" /TD "NEWDOMAIN" /TO "{{target_ou}}"

domain_migration.name: Migrate Computer to New Domain
domain_migration.description: Join computer to new domain (post-ADMT or manual)
domain_migration.template:
# Join to new domain (run on target computer)
Add-Computer -DomainName '{{new_domain}}' -OUPath '{{ou_path}}' -Restart

domain_migration.name: Export AD Users for Migration
domain_migration.description: Export users from an OU for migration planning
domain_migration.template:
# Export AD Users for Migration
#Requires -Modules ActiveDirectory
Get-ADUser -Filter * -SearchBase '{{ou_path}}' -Properties * | Select-Object Name, SamAccountName, UserPrincipalName, Mail, GivenName, Surname | Export-Csv '{{export_path}}' -NoTypeInformation

domain_migration.name: Migration Readiness Check
domain_migration.description: Check AD environment for migration readiness
domain_migration.template:
# Migration Readiness Check
#Requires -Modules ActiveDirectory
$users = Get-ADUser -Filter * -SearchBase '{{ou_path}}' -Properties LastLogonDate, Enabled
Write-Host "Total users: $($users.Count)"
Write-Host "Enabled: $(($users | Where-Object Enabled).Count)"
Write-Host "Disabled: $(($users | Where-Object {!$_.Enabled}).Count)"
$users | Select-Object Name, SamAccountName, LastLogonDate, Enabled | Format-Table -AutoSize

microsoft_office.name: Repair Office Installation
microsoft_office.template:
cd %ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Office\Office16
for /d %%i in (*) do "%%i\OfficeClickToRun.exe" scenario=repair platform=x86 repairtype=QuickRepair

microsoft_office.name: Clear Office Cache
microsoft_office.template:
# Clear Office Cache
Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Office\16.0\OfficeFileCache\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Office\UnsavedFiles\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Office cache cleared'
